description: This file defines an audit logging function for persisting audit entries to a database. It includes logic to create the audit_log table if it doesn't exist and inserts new audit records with details such as action, resource, user ID, IP address, and timestamp. It interacts with database connection and configuration modules and handles exceptions silently.

methods.name: None audit_log( action: str, resource: str, resource_id: Optional[int], details: dict[str, Any] | None, user_id: Optional[int], ip: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Persists an audit log entry if auditing is enabled. It creates the audit_log table if it doesn't exist and inserts a new record with provided details, handling errors silently to avoid impacting business flow.
